data.Remarks: MOI is Accepted. The portfolio presented by the candidate includes: 1. Black and white graphic work – 3 drawings (material – pencil, ink, black felt-tip pen, etc. The format of the work must not exceed A3); 2. Work done in color – 3 drawings (material: watercolor, tempera, gouache, colored pencil, pastel, colored markers, acrylic, mixed media is allowed; the format of the work should not exceed A3); 3. Free work that demonstrates his/her individual creative abilities – 3 drawings (the format of the work should not exceed A3); Exam “Free Composition” includes : 1. Free graphic (black and white) composition; 2. The work is done in A3 format (material: black pencil, ink pen, black felt-tip pen, etc.); 3. The maximum total score of the work will be 48 points;
